summary.key_theme: F5 透過與 NVIDIA 合作推動 AI 基礎設施佈局，並在財報前夕展現強勁的應用安全與雲端需求動能。

bullish.title: F5 and Telenor Partner to Build the AI Service Plane for Sovereign AI on NVIDIA-powered AI Factory Infrastructure

bullish.title: F5 to Report Q4 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
